details: A significantly weaker-than-expected US jobs report for June, showing only 57,000 nonfarm payrolls, has led to a decrease in market expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate hikes and a higher probability of near-term monetary easing. This macroeconomic relief triggered a rebound in risk assets, including cryptocurrencies, with Bitcoin climbing above $61,000.
title: US Jobs Report Boosts Crypto Market

details: Following a dismal June marked by a 10-day outflow streak, US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have reversed course, recording $221.7 million in net inflows. This significant turnaround, the largest daily haul in about two months, was largely attributed to the softened US labor market data. Fidelity's FBTC led the inflows with $166 million.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Major Inflows After Losing Streak

details: The overall cryptocurrency market experienced a rebound, with the global crypto market cap increasing by approximately 0.97% over the last 24 hours to reach $2.14 trillion. This recovery comes as Bitcoin reclaimed the $61,000 level and other major altcoins also saw gains, reflecting improved investor sentiment driven by macro developments.
title: Global Crypto Market Cap Rebounds
